title: Lost in Translation
tagline: Jet lagged, wide awake, and hungry.
about: A fading actor and a young woman, both stuck awake in a Tokyo hotel, form an unlikely bond.

    StartersHotel bar edamame and nutsSalted sesame edamame with rice crackers and wasabi peasHow to make it400g frozen edamameflaky salt, to taste1 tsp sesame oil1 packet rice crackers100g wasabi peasSteam the edamame.Toss with flaky salt and a little sesame oil.Serve in small bowls with rice crackers and wasabi peas.Karaoke night karaageSoy and ginger marinated chicken, double fried until crisp, with mayo and lemonHow to make it700g chicken thighs2 tbsp soy sauce1 tbsp sake1 tsp grated ginger1 garlic clove100g potato starch2 L vegetable oil3 tbsp mayonnaise1 lemonCut the chicken into pieces and mix with the soy, sake, ginger and crushed garlic.Marinate in the fridge.Coat in potato starch and fry in the vegetable oil at 160°C, then rest.Fry again at 190°C until crisp.Serve with mayonnaise and lemon.3am tuna mayo and salmon onigiriThe 3am walks through the cityHow to make itAs written, serves 4Warm seasoned short grain rice pressed into triangles around tuna mayo or flaked salted salmon, wrapped in crisp nori just before eating.Wash 400g short grain rice until clear and cook with 480ml water.Season with salt and cool until just warm.Mix a 185g tin of tuna with 3 tbsp Japanese mayo and a little soy.Salt a 200g salmon fillet, grill 8 minutes and flake.With wet, salted hands shape 8 triangles, pushing a spoon of filling into the middle of each.Wrap with nori strips just before eating.Wagyu katsu sandoRoom service at 3am, Charlotte still awake.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsShabu-shabuThin sliced beef, tofu and vegetables swished in kombu broth, dipped in ponzuHow to make it1 piece kombu2 L water600g thinly sliced beef300g firm tofu1/4 wombok100g enoki mushrooms1 bunch spring onions1 bottle ponzu300g short grain riceSoak the kombu in the water.Slice the wombok, enoki and spring onions, slice the tofu and arrange on platters with the beef.Cook the rice.Bring the broth to a simmer at the table. Swish the beef, tofu and vegetables through the broth and dip in ponzu.Kyoto kitsune udon with soft eggCharlotte's day trip to the templesHow to make itAs written, serves 4Thick udon in a dashi of kombu and bonito with soy and mirin, topped with sweet simmered tofu, a soft egg, spring onion and tempura flakes.Soak a 10cm piece of kombu in 1.6L water for 30 minutes, bring to a simmer, remove and add 20g bonito flakes.Steep 5 minutes and strain, then season with 4 tbsp soy and 3 tbsp mirin.Simmer 4 fried tofu pouches in 200ml of the broth with 1 tbsp sugar for 10 minutes.Boil 4 eggs for 6.5 minutes.Cook 800g fresh udon for 2 minutes, divide into bowls and top with broth, tofu, halved eggs, spring onion and tempura flakes.SweetsMatcha soft serveCreamy matcha ice cream scooped into waffle conesHow to make it2 tbsp matcha powder395g condensed milk400ml thickened cream4 waffle conesWhisk the matcha into the condensed milk.Whip the cream to soft peaks and fold through.Freeze.Scoop soft into waffle cones.DrinksJapanese whisky highballJapanese whisky and cold soda water over ice with a lemon twistHow to make it180ml Japanese whisky1 L soda water1 lemonice, to servePack four tall glasses with ice.Add the whisky to each and top with very cold soda water.Stir once and add a twist of lemon.
